OSFI-B10-AuditAccess.evidence: the Bank's internal audit team may inspect the Provider's records and systems
OSFI-B10-AuditAccess.reason: The clause grants audit rights only to the Bank and does not preserve OSFI’s rights of audit, examination, or access to information regardless of location.

OSFI-B10-BCP.evidence: The Provider shall maintain a written business continuity plan ("BCP") covering the Services.
OSFI-B10-BCP.reason: The document requires a BCP but does not include disaster-recovery provisions or specify recovery objectives such as RTO or RPO.

OSFI-B10-ExitPlan.evidence: Either party may terminate this Agreement for material uncured breach on 60 days' written notice.
OSFI-B10-ExitPlan.reason: The document only defines termination rights and does not include an exit plan with triggers, transition assistance, or data return/destruction provisions.

OSFI-B10-Subcontracting.evidence: The Provider may subcontract any portion of the Services to any affiliate or qualified third party.
OSFI-B10-Subcontracting.reason: The clause permits subcontracting without requiring prior notice or consent from the FRFI and does not extend FRFI rights through the subcontracting chain.

OSFI-B10-TPRMF.evidence: The Bank maintains policies for managing its third-party relationships at an enterprise level.
OSFI-B10-TPRMF.reason: While enterprise-level policies are acknowledged, the document does not specify a TPRMF with defined accountabilities, risk-tiering methodology, or lifecycle management policies.
